name: Ship's Passing
source:
SHIP'S PASSING is a dating sim about non-normative intimacies - relationships that fall outside of the (heterosexual, monogamous, etc.) norm.

Jaycee Gonzaga is on a cruise! Having just won a ticket in a cereal box sweepstakes, they have the grand fortune of getting to relax on a nice Capybara-themed cruise ship for two weeks...alone.

Join Jaycee on their vacation as they meet all the colorful personalities on the ship, and try to figure out why they decided to surround themselves with strangers for 14 days straight. Fall in love, make some friends, or just make some memories!

[from [url=https://juiceboxjulia.itch.io/ships-passing]Itch.io[/url]]
